name: domain-watchdog
description: Domain Watchdog monitors domain names using RDAP, tracks their history, and helps you acquire them when they expire. Requires an existing PostgreSQL and Redis container on the same Docker network. Also deploy the domain-watchdog-worker container. Before starting, create the database: docker exec -it YOUR_POSTGRES_CONTAINER psql -U YOUR_USER -c "CREATE DATABASE domainwatchdog;"

paths.name: Public Content
paths.description: User-uploaded public content. Create a home.md file here to customize the landing page.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port to access the Domain Watchdog web interface.

variables.name: JWT Passphrase
variables.description: Passphrase used to encrypt JWT keypair. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32 — If changing this on an existing install, regenerate keys with: docker exec domain-watchdog php /app/bin/console lexik:jwt:generate-keypair --overwrite

variables.name: App Environment
variables.description: Leave as prod.

variables.name: App Secret
variables.description: Random secret key. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: Secure Cookies
variables.description: Set to true if behind a reverse proxy with SSL. Set to false for plain HTTP direct access.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Internal Caddy binding. Leave as :80.

variables.name: Outgoing IP
variables.description: Your server's outgoing public IP address. Required for some domain connectors/registrars.

variables.name: Enable Registration
variables.description: Allow new users to register. Set to false to lock down the instance.

variables.name: Verify Email on Registration
variables.description: Require email verification on signup. Requires a working Mailer DSN.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Full PostgreSQL connection string. Format: postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@CONTAINER_NAME:PORT/DATABASE?serverVersion=VERSION&charset=utf8

variables.name: Redis Async DSN
variables.description: Redis connection for async messages. Format: redis://CONTAINER_NAME:PORT/messages?lazy=1

variables.name: Redis RDAP Low DSN
variables.description: Redis connection for low-priority RDAP messages.

variables.name: Redis RDAP High DSN
variables.description: Redis connection for high-priority RDAP messages.

variables.name: Redis Lock DSN
variables.description: Redis connection for distributed locking. Format: redis://CONTAINER_NAME:PORT

variables.name: Mailer DSN
variables.description: SMTP connection for email alerts. Example: smtp://user:pass@smtp.example.com:587 — Leave as null://null to disable.

variables.name: Mailer Sender Name
variables.description: Display name for outgoing notification emails.

variables.name: Mailer Sender Email
variables.description: Sender address for outgoing notification emails.

variables.name: OAuth Client ID
variables.description: OAuth2/OIDC client ID. Leave blank to disable SSO.

variables.name: OAuth Client Secret
variables.description: OAuth2/OIDC client secret.

variables.name: OAuth Authorization URL
variables.description: OAuth2 authorization endpoint URL.

variables.name: OAuth Token URL
variables.description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL.

variables.name: OAuth UserInfo URL
variables.description: OAuth2 userinfo endpoint URL.

variables.name: OAuth Scope
variables.description: OAuth2 scopes to request. Example: openid profile email

variables.name: SSO Auto Redirect
variables.description: Automatically redirect to SSO login instead of showing the local login form.
